It is produced by Shinya Tasaki, honorary president of the Japan Sommelier Association, and run by Tasaki's company Santir. Smart-casual dress, and no strong perfume.

tokyo_la_scene_mercure_hibiya.notes: [French · hotel lounge at Mercure Tokyo Hibiya] The all-day restaurant, café and bar of the Mercure Tokyo Hibiya, open since December 2023. Its 77 seats are spread over sofas, tables, a private room and a semi-private room in a basement that still gets natural light, and you can reach it underground from Shimbashi without getting rained on. Surprisingly quiet for Shimbashi. The weekend lunch set includes a drink, a choice of four appetizers and a fish, meat or pasta main, with unlimited bread. Tea-time regulars come for the seasonal fruit tart, with a crisp crust, and flavoured teas such as mango-strawberry. Truffle fries are on the bar menu. Staff were kind even to a diner in sweatpants.
